dtype: float16 (V100 has no bfloat16; checkpoint is bf16-native)
inference: single deterministic forward pass; no sampling; final A/B logits are the behavioral signal
lens_method: logit lens: final RMSNorm (Gemma4RMSNorm, eps 1e-6, with learned scale) then lm_head, applied to each decoder layer's last-position output
j_lens: not available in this repo; columns left empty
